description: This Java source file implements an asynchronous command response consumer for the Eclipse Hono client, built on Vertx-Proton. It defines a class that creates and manages message consumers to handle async responses from a Hono server, specifically for a given tenantId and replyId.

classes.name: AsyncCommandResponseConsumerImpl
classes.description: A Vertx-Proton based client for consuming async command response messages from a Hono server.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new asynchronous command response consumer for a tenant for commands with the given replyId. Sets up the receiver address and returns a Future wrapping the message consumer.
